templates.label: Scene Reveal
templates.purpose: First-pass scene art for a location reveal or moody exploration beat.
templates.positiveTemplate: Dark cinematic tabletop RPG scene, {location}, {time_of_day}, {weather}, {tone}, practical environmental detail, grounded fantasy atmosphere, readable composition, no text, no watermark.
templates.negativeTemplate: text, watermark, logo, blurry anatomy, low-detail faces, modern clothing, duplicate limbs, UI overlay.
safetyNotes: Keep prompts aligned with the campaign content rating.
Do not leak GM-only twists or hidden threats into player-visible art.

templates.label: Portrait Variant
templates.purpose: Prep-time portrait or visual-canon generation for recurring characters.
templates.positiveTemplate: Portrait of {subject_name}, {role}, {distinctive_features}, {expression}, moody practical lighting, grounded dark fantasy, expressive face, consistent silhouette, no text, no watermark.
templates.negativeTemplate: text, watermark, celebrity likeness, copyrighted character design, extra faces, distorted hands, mismatched eyes.
safetyNotes: Avoid real player likenesses unless explicitly approved.
Keep recurring character features consistent with accepted reference packs.

templates.label: Location Study
templates.purpose: Environmental still focused on layout, landmarks, and atmosphere rather than an action beat.
templates.positiveTemplate: Dark fantasy location study of {location}, {landmarks}, {lighting}, {mood}, rich material texture, grounded scale cues, no text, no watermark.
templates.negativeTemplate: text, watermark, map labels, UI framing, modern signage, oversaturated neon, duplicated architecture.
safetyNotes: Player-facing versions should avoid hidden rooms, unrevealed clues, or tactical spoilers.

templates.label: Item Or Clue
templates.purpose: Close-up prop shot for clues, relics, loot, and handout-style reveals.
templates.positiveTemplate: Detailed close-up of {object_name}, {material_detail}, {context_detail}, dramatic side lighting, grounded dark fantasy prop study, no text, no watermark.
templates.negativeTemplate: text, watermark, floating UI, modern packaging, duplicate objects, toy-like proportions.
safetyNotes: Avoid copyrighted logos, proprietary setting references, or direct reproductions of published handouts.
